insight.headline: App security updates: Thank you, plus what's required next
insight.what_changed: Thanks to you, we've already seen the vast majority of apps that run bulk operations adopt an IP allowlist. That's a big step toward keeping merchants protected heading into the busiest weeks of the year. Here's what's required, what's new, and what's coming next. Action required All public apps that call the Admin API: Turn on an IP allowlist by November 20, 2026 at 11:59 PM ET. Apps without one…
